sections.overview: This freshwater catfish is known from the Orinoco basin in Colombia and Venezuela. The taxonomic revision distinguishes it from P. magdaleniatum, which is endemic to the Magdalena basin.
sections.identification: Its sides bear scattered dark spots, a few straight bars and two or three loop-shaped bars; the pectoral and pelvic fins are pale.
sections.habitat: FishBase classifies it as a demersal freshwater fish; detailed habitat preferences were not given in the consulted summaries.
sections.diet: Species-specific diet information was not available in the consulted accounts.
sections.behavior: The consulted species summaries provide no specific behavioral description.
sections.reproduction: The consulted species summaries provide no specific reproductive details.
sections.ecology: Its range separates it from the Magdalena-basin congener P. magdaleniatum; the two names represent distinct species in the cited revision.
sections.conservation: FishBase reports a global IUCN assessment of Endangered, dated 2020.
